notes.title: New level pack: Chromatic
notes.content:
Put your spatial reasoning and illusion sorting skills to the test with Chromatic, a collection of 10 new puzzles. These challenging 2 – 4 color puzzles drop in a free update on Friday, October 11.

As always, you can chat with Optica players and the game makers on our [url=http://discord.gg/glitch]Discord[/url]. Find hints and collaborate on tricky levels together in the #optica channel.

notes.title: Get Connected for Puzzle Hints & Optica Updates
notes.content:
Stuck on a level, searching for the latest Optica updates, or want to connect with our team? Look no further.

[b]CONNECT ON DISCORD[/b]
Chat with Optica players + the game makers, find hints, and collaborate on tricky levels together in our Discord. We’ve already seen some amazing teamwork solving puzzles in the dedicated Optica channel.
